{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_03","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_03 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. item.text: {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_03","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24 12:00:00')), latest AS (SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), inv AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'), sums AS (SELECT i.event_key, i.amount_minor gross, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM latest p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0) pays, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM latest c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0) credits, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM latest h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0) holds, i.currency, i.business_date, i.terms_code, i.discount_until FROM inv i), amounts AS (SELECT s.*, MAX(0,gross-pays-credits) remaining, (SELECT t.discount_bps FROM latest t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.event_key=s.terms_code AND t.business_date <= s.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) bps, (SELECT f.fx_num FROM latest f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.event_key LIKE s.currency||'%' AND f.business_date <= s.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) fxn, (SELECT f.fx_den FROM latest f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.event_key LIKE s.currency||'%' AND f.business_date <= s.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) fxd FROM sums s), calculated AS (SELECT *, MAX(0,remaining-holds) unheld FROM amounts) SELECT SUM(CAST((2 * (unheld * CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= discount_until THEN 10000-COALESCE(bps,0) ELSE 10000 END) * fxn + fxd*10000) / (2 * fxd * 10000) AS INTEGER)) total_usd_cents FROM calculated WHERE fxn IS NOT NULL AND fxd IS NOT NULL AND bps IS NOT NULL"}}
